title: Bananas (per lb)

adjustment.analysis: No events, promotions, or price changes are scheduled. The baseline already reflects recent seasonal trends (back-to-school) and recent volatility. The Labor Day week (2026-09-07) was a significant dip (241 units, vs baseline 431), but this was a one-time holiday effect and not a recurring driver. The price is unchanged at $0.67, and no promotion is planned. The classical uplift model confirms no expected lift. The recent drop in sales (2026-09-14: 306) is below baseline but not attributable to a known driver. No evidence supports a deviation from baseline. The median multiplier remains 1.0.
